accentList.description: Rows of text, each marked by a coloured bar at its edge.
accentList.name: Accent Bar List
balance.description: A beam that tips toward the side with more sub-items. Shows two items.
balance.name: Balance
basicCycle.description: Circles round a ring with curved arrows: a repeating sequence.
basicCycle.name: Cycle
basicMatrix.description: Four blocks in a square. Shows four items.
basicMatrix.name: Quadrants
basicProcess.description: Boxes joined by arrows, for steps taken in order.
basicProcess.name: Steps
basicPyramid.description: Levels from a narrow top to a broad base.
basicPyramid.name: Pyramid
basicVenn.description: Circles that overlap, for ideas that share ground.
basicVenn.name: Overlapping Circles
bendingProcess.description: Many steps in rows that wrap, read like lines of text.
bendingProcess.name: Winding Steps
blockCycle.description: Labels sit on a broad ring of arrows that turns continuously.
blockCycle.name: Ring Cycle
blockList.description: Equal blocks in rows, for items that need no order. Sub-items list inside their block.
blockList.name: Block List
chevronProcess.description: Chevrons that point the way, with sub-items listed under each.
chevronProcess.name: Chevron Steps
continuousArrow.description: Steps laid along one broad arrow, for continuous progress.
continuousArrow.name: Arrow Track
cycleMatrix.description: A circle in four parts, with sub-items in the corners. Shows four items.
cycleMatrix.name: Quartered Circle
equation.description: Items that add up to a result: the last item follows the equals sign.
equation.name: Equation
gridMatrix.description: Four boxes placed by two crossing axes. Shows four items.
gridMatrix.name: Axis Grid
hierarchyList.description: Headings across the top with their sub-items in indented boxes below.
hierarchyList.name: Tree List
horizontalBulletList.description: A heading for each column with its sub-items listed beneath.
horizontalBulletList.name: Column Headings
horizontalHierarchy.description: A tree that branches from left to right, for decisions and breakdowns.
horizontalHierarchy.name: Sideways Tree
invertedPyramid.description: Levels from a broad top narrowing downward.
invertedPyramid.name: Funnel Pyramid
linedList.description: Text on ruled lines: each heading on the left, its sub-items to the right.
linedList.name: Ruled List
opposingArrows.description: Two arrows pointing apart, for opposing forces or choices. Shows two items.
opposingArrows.name: Opposing Arrows
orgChart.description: Who reports to whom, from the top down. Sub-items become the boxes below.
orgChart.name: Organization Chart
pyramidList.description: A pyramid with a labelled box for each level across it.
pyramidList.name: Pyramid Labels
radialCycle.description: A central item with related items round it. The first item is the hub; its sub-items are the spokes.
radialCycle.name: Hub and Spokes
radialVenn.description: Circles that overlap a central one. The first item is the centre.
radialVenn.name: Centre Overlap
segmentedCycle.description: Wedges of one circle, for the parts of a whole that repeat.
segmentedCycle.name: Segmented Circle
segmentedPyramid.description: A pyramid of triangle tiles, one for each item.
segmentedPyramid.name: Tiled Pyramid
stackedList.description: A round badge crowns each column of sub-items.
stackedList.name: Badge Columns
stepUpProcess.description: Columns that climb from left to right, for progress or growth.
stepUpProcess.name: Rising Steps
tableHierarchy.description: Each item spans the items beneath it, like a table of levels.
tableHierarchy.name: Stacked Tree
target.description: Rings that close in on a centre, each labelled to the side.
target.name: Target
textCycle.description: Words round a circle linked by thin arrows, with room for more text.
textCycle.name: Text Cycle
timeline.description: Milestones on a line, their labels above and below in turn.
timeline.name: Timeline
titledMatrix.description: Four quadrants round a title. The first item is the title; its sub-items fill the quadrants.
titledMatrix.name: Titled Quadrants
verticalBulletList.description: Wide headings down the page, each over a panel listing its sub-items.
verticalBulletList.name: Stacked Headings
verticalChevronList.description: Downward chevrons, one per row, with the sub-items beside them.
verticalChevronList.name: Chevron Rows
verticalProcess.description: Boxes from top to bottom joined by arrows.
verticalProcess.name: Downward Steps
